gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/presets/platform/supabase/manifest.toml)

Checks that every migration is named fourteen digits, an underscore, and snake case words.

## Why

The CLI orders and records migrations by this name, and it skips a file it cannot read a version from.

## What to do

Create the migration with supabase migration new <name>, which writes the name.

## Where it runs

- Preset: [the supabase preset](/reference/presets/supabase/)
- Stage: commit
- Level: all
- Engine: integrity

Turn it off for a path with a reason: `gspot ignore supabase/migration-names --paths <glob> --reason "<why>"`.
